about: factorio-play 0.1.1, construct_smelting_line: the MCP tools (name, description, input and output schema, under mcp 1.30.0) and the prompts. 0.2.0 must keep them.

tools.name: blocked_tiles
tools.description: Tiles nothing can stand or be built on (water), sorted. Costs no decision.

tools.name: decisions_left
tools.description: Decisions the build phase still allows.

tools.name: entities
tools.description:
The entity table, nearest first: row, kind, x, y, facing, fuel, contents,
        output, working, remembered. Rows renumber as the character moves, so read it
        again before give/take/mine. Costs no decision.

tools.name: finish
tools.description:
End the build phase. The episode then runs its verification window and is
        scored; call this once the line is built and fuelled. Nothing can be done after.

tools.name: give
tools.description: Move `amount` (1, 5 or 20) of `item` from the inventory into entity `row`.

tools.name: inventory
tools.description: Every item name -> count held. Costs no decision.

tools.name: last_refused
tools.description: Whether the game refused the last action (a legal intent that failed).

tools.name: me
tools.description: The character's position in tiles, [x, y]. Costs no decision.

tools.name: move
tools.description:
Walk one decision in `direction` (N/E/S/W, or north/east/south/west) with
        stride "long" (~4.5 tiles), "step" (~1) or "nudge" (~0.3). If it is refused,
        the result says why.

tools.name: ore_tiles
tools.description: Resource tiles of `kind` within 12 tiles, sorted. Costs no decision.

tools.name: patch
tools.description: The ore patch's centre [x, y] (the task's public marker), or null.

tools.name: place
tools.description:
Place `item` on tile (x, y) facing N/E/S/W (or north/east/south/west); a
        2x2 machine covers x..x+1, y..y+1. Reaches 5 tiles from tile(), never the
        character's own tile. If it is refused, the result says why.

tools.name: take
tools.description: Move `amount` (1, 5 or 20) of `item` out of entity `row` into the inventory.

tools.name: tile
tools.description: The tile the character stands on, [x, y] (floor of me). Costs no decision.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Let `count` decisions (30 ticks each, at most 100) pass.

system_prompt:
You build factories in a Factorio-like simulator by calling tools.

Task: construct_smelting_line.
The scene has an iron ore patch. The character starts holding 2 burner mining drills, 2 stone furnaces and 60 coal. Build a working smelting line: a burner mining drill on ore whose output drops into a stone furnace, with both machines fuelled, so that at least 10 iron plates are machine-made during a verification window after the build phase. Some scenes have walls; walking straight into a wall wastes decisions.

You act through tools that mirror the `world` API one to one: queries (me, tile, inventory, ore_tiles, blocked_tiles, entities, patch, decisions_left, last_refused) cost nothing; actions (move, place, give, take, mine, wait) each spend a decision. give/take/mine name an entity by its current `row` in entities(). Every tool returns {"ok": ..., "result": ...} or an error. Call finish() once the line is built and fuelled: the episode is scored only after finish().

Game notes:
- Every action is one decision of about 30 ticks.
- The build phase has a 600-decision budget; running out ends it.
- `place` only reaches tiles within 5 tiles (Chebyshev distance) of the character's own tile, never the tile the character stands on, and never an occupied or blocked tile.
- A 2x2 machine placed at (x, y) covers tiles x..x+1, y..y+1; its centre is (x+1, y+1).
- A burner mining drill facing S drops its ore at about (cx+0.5, cy+1.3) from its centre (cx, cy); rotating the facing rotates that point about the centre.
- A furnace catches the ore if its 2x2 footprint contains the drop point.
- Both machines need fuel (coal) to run.
- A drill only mines if its footprint is on ore.
